summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K reporting a Nasdaq deficiency notice after a 1-for-35 reverse stock split reduced publicly held shares to ~401,226 (below the 500,000 minimum). The company subsequently restored compliance via exercise of pre-funded warrants on May 4, 2026, bringing publicly held shares to 513,939. No board recommendation, financial advisor, or deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine listing compliance update with no special-situation transaction.
